lines.en: label toukaspring1:
scene bedroom_day
I tap on Touka’s name in my phone as the amount of interpersonal training I have forced myself to endure throughout my time here now somewhat allows me to remember plans I personally made.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Touka 的名字。在这儿逼自己受了这么多「人际训练」，如今我总算能想起自己定下的约定了。

lines.en: And today is the day I planned on taking Touka out and “groveling” or whatever it is she’s going to get a high off of making me do.
lines.zh: 而今天，就是我打算带 Touka 出去、「低声下气」赔罪的日子——管它是什么，反正能让她从使唤我中获得快感。

lines.en: To be honest, I can’t imagine there will be much groveling at all as, like me, I think she’s mostly just talk.
lines.zh: 说实话，我想象不出会有多少「低声下气」，因为我觉得她跟我一样，多半只是嘴上说说。

lines.en: She’s far too kind to push me off the pedestal I’ve spent thirty-one (and more) years building and will probably just make me say generic nice things to her or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 她太善良了，不会把我从那个花了三十一年（还不止）才堆起来的高台上推下去——多半只会让我对她说几句泛泛的好话之类的。

lines.en: : Hello? Sensei?
lines.zh: : 喂？Sensei？

lines.en: Which means I have to hit her with my greatest pick-up line right now so I can sail smoothly through-out the rest of the day.
lines.zh: 也就是说，我现在得用我最厉害的搭讪开场白砸她，好让今天剩下的时间顺顺当当。

lines.en: : Hey.
Or at least that’s what I would say if I knew any pick-up lines.
lines.zh: 至少，要是我懂什么搭讪话术的话，我会这么说。

lines.en: : Hay is for horses. And, as today will be your day of groveling, I demand a more formal greeting. One that is at least {i}somewhat{/i} memorable.
lines.zh: : 「嘿」是喂马的。既然今天是你的「赔罪日」，我要求一个更正式的问候。一个{i}多少{/i}能让人记住的。

lines.en: : Welcome to today, esteemed and beautiful Touka Tsukioka. May fortune continue to favor you and may the gods smile down on your suspicious womanly figure.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到今天，尊贵而美丽的 Touka Tsukioka。愿好运继续眷顾你，愿众神对你那可疑的婀娜身姿微笑。

lines.en: : Suspicious?
lines.zh: : 可疑？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s kind of unfair that you’re more physically developed than some women I know in their 30’s.
lines.zh: : 对。你发育得比我认识的一些三十多岁的女性都好，这有点不公平。

lines.en: : Well, I shan’t say that was formal. But I suppose you’ve nailed the memorable bit.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这可算不上「正式」。不过我想，「让人记住」这点你倒是做到了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I have a lot more experience than most when it comes to nailing things.
lines.zh: : 是啊，在「搞定」事情这方面，我比大多数人都有经验。

lines.en: : Is that so? I didn’t take you as a handyman.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我还不知道你是个修理工。

lines.en: : I’m not a handyman, but I sure am handy with my hands.
lines.zh: : 我不是修理工，但我这双手确实很「巧」。

lines.en: : Well, yes. They are hands. They are handy by nature.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对。它们毕竟是手。天生就「巧」。

lines.en: I hang up so I can completely restart this phone call in a way that is hopefully much less awkward.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，好彻底重打一遍，希望这次别那么尴尬。

lines.en: : Hello again.
lines.zh: : 又是我，喂。

lines.en: : I’m sorry you had to hear any of that.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉让你听见了那些。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I was just about to do the same thing.
lines.zh: : 没事。我刚才也正打算干同样的事。

lines.en: : This is why I don’t normally call people first-thing in the morning. Especially lately since it’s been getting way harder to pull myself out of dream-mentality.
lines.zh: : 所以我平常才不大清早给人打电话。尤其最近，越来越难从「做梦状态」里拔出来了。

lines.en: : I suppose I can somewhat relate. To what do I owe the pleasure, though?
lines.zh: : 我大概能体会一点。不过，你今天找我有何贵干？

lines.en: : I told you I was going to call today, didn’t I? We made plans to do stuff while I was out camping.
lines.zh: : 我说过今天会打给你，对吧？我们去露营那会儿约好了要一起做点事。

lines.en: : I suppose we did. But I was under the impression that you were either going to cancel or just disappear again.
lines.zh: : 好像是约过。不过我当时以为，你要么会取消，要么又会玩消失。

lines.en: : Well, I guess this is me proving you wrong then. When can you meet up?
lines.zh: : 好吧，那这就算我证明你猜错了。你什么时候能出来？

lines.en: : Whenever I find out {i}where{/i} we’ll be meeting up. Because, unlike you, I’ve already been awake for several hours- {i}patiently{/i} waiting for your call.
lines.zh: : 等我知道{i}在哪儿{/i}碰头的时候。因为跟你不一样，我已经醒了好几个小时——一直在{i}耐心{/i}等你的电话。

lines.en: : Bullshit. Just three seconds ago you said you expected me to cancel.
lines.zh: : 胡说。三秒前你还说你料定我会取消。

lines.en: : Yes, that’s correct. I was just trying my hand at sarcasm, but I feel as if I haven’t quite gotten it down yet. If you want the truth, I just got out of the bath.
lines.zh: : 对，没错。我刚才只是在试着用反讽，但感觉还没掌握好。要说实话，我刚洗完澡。

lines.en: : I have no response to that that wouldn’t ruin this phone call.
lines.zh: : 对这句话，我任何回应都会毁了这通电话。

lines.en: : My! Look at you, Sensei — acting so uncharacteristically mature despite having just opened your eyes. I admire the restraint.
lines.zh: : 哎呀！瞧瞧你，Sensei——明明刚睁开眼，却表现得一反常态地成熟。我佩服这份克制。

lines.en: : It {i}does{/i} make me feel slightly lonely, though
lines.zh: : 不过这也让我有点寂寞。

lines.en: : Why would that make you-
lines.zh: : 那怎么会让你——

lines.en: : One hour. We can meet near the vending machine.
lines.zh: : 一小时后。我们在自动贩卖机附近碰头。

lines.en: : Touka, we live in Japan. There’s a vending machine on every corner.
lines.zh: : Touka，我们可是在日本。每个街角都有自动贩卖机。

lines.en: : You know the one I mean, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你知道我说的是哪台，Sensei。

lines.en: : Ciao.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: scene black
I’m annoyed because she’s right. There’s only one vending machine that holds any sort of significance for us, but even then it’s {i}still{/i} just a machine.
lines.zh: 我有点恼火，因为她说得对。对我们俩有意义的自动贩卖机只有一台——但{i}即便如此{/i}，它也只是台机器。

lines.en: Regardless — after getting dressed and preparing for the day, I walk out into the living room to find Ami watching television on the couch.
lines.zh: 不管怎样——换好衣服、收拾好准备出门后，我走进客厅，看见 Ami 正窝在沙发上看电视。

lines.en: It’s a simple sight, but one that I’ve forgotten over the last several months. And I’m glad I can finally see it again, as silly as that sounds.
lines.zh: 很平常的一幕，却是过去几个月里我忘掉了的。能再看到它，我很高兴——虽然听着有点傻。

lines.en: But when she asks me where I’m going, I lie.
lines.zh: 可当她问我要去哪儿时，我撒了谎。

lines.en: There’s no need to. I’m sure she wouldn’t stop me if she knew the truth.
lines.zh: 其实没必要。我敢说她就算知道真相，也不会拦我。

lines.en: But I do it anyway, because there always needs to be {i}something.{/i} And if there’s anything I’m good at (apart from nailing things or tormenting rich girls), it’s building mole hills for someone else to turn into mountains.
lines.zh: 但我还是撒了，因为总得有点{i}什么{/i}。而且，要说有什么是我擅长的（除了「搞定事情」和「捉弄富家女」），那就是给别人堆个小土丘，好让他们把它当成大山。

lines.en: When I leave the house, I look behind me. But I’m not sure quite why.
lines.zh: 出门时，我回头看了一眼。但我不太确定为什么。

lines.en: I don’t think I’m being followed.
lines.zh: 我不觉得有人在跟踪我。

lines.en: But I think I wish I was.
lines.zh: 但我想，我希望有。

lines.en: scene toukadateday1
: Well, would you look at that? It’s only been forty-five minutes, Sensei. Were you so excited to see me that you left early?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你瞧瞧？才过了四十五分钟呢，Sensei。你是太想见我，所以提前出门了？

lines.en: : No, I just didn’t stop for coffee on the way over like I originally decided to.
lines.zh: : 不是，我只是没按原计划在路上停下来喝咖啡。

lines.en: scene toukadateday2
: One sentence in and you’ve already ruined our date. Impressive.
lines.zh: : 才一句话，你就把我们的约会毁了。真厉害。

lines.en: : Sure. Except that this isn’t really a “date” and more of just a way for me to show you how sorry I am for causing you to worry for so long. I’m doing it for everyone.
lines.zh: : 行吧。只不过这算不上「约会」，更像是我向你表达「让你担心这么久，我很抱歉」的一种方式。我这是在为大家做这件事。

lines.en: : Wow, and now you’ve made it even worse. Is there no limit to your undesirableness?
lines.zh: : 哇，这下更糟了。你这讨人厌的本事没个底线吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no. I just tend to say things like that when I’m worried about getting closer to someone.
lines.zh: : 还真没有。我只是……担心跟谁走得太近时，就会说这种话。

lines.en: scene toukadateday3

: So you {i}do{/i} see us getting closer...but you also see me the same way as everyone else...while setting up a meeting that only exists because I asked you to do something to prove that you {i}don’t{/i} see me that way.
lines.zh: : 所以你{i}确实{/i}觉得我们在走近……可你又把我和别人一视同仁……而这一切，还是因为你答应过我、要做点什么来证明你{i}不是{/i}那么看我的。

lines.en: : I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 我被绕晕了。

lines.en: scene toukadateday4
: So I’m just going to say it’s a date. And if that word does not accurately describe what’s truly happening here, you can internalize it, for doing the opposite will only make me feel unwanted.
lines.zh: : 那我干脆就说这是约会。要是这个词没准确描述这儿正在发生的事，你就往肚子里咽——因为说反话只会让我觉得你不想要我。

lines.en: : Sure. Do whatever you want. Just don’t expect me to take you to some fancy French restaurant like you did for me when {i}you{/i} got to choose the date.
lines.zh: : 行。随{i}你{/i}便。只是别指望我带你吃什么高档法餐——那是你赢得「选约会」那回才有的待遇。

lines.en: scene toukadateday5
: Oh, I remember that day. It’s when you chose Chika over me. What a lovely memory.
lines.zh: : 哦，我记得那天。就是你选了 Chika 而没选我那天。多美好的回忆。

lines.en: : I barely knew you at the time, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我那时还几乎不认识你，Touka。

lines.en: scene toukadateday1
: So you’re saying you’d choose differently if that contest took place today?
lines.zh: : 所以你是说，要是那场比赛放今天，你会选别人？

lines.en: : Is everything you say today going to be carefully designed to make things as hard as possible?
lines.zh: : 你今天说的每句话，是不是都精心设计过、好把场面搞得越难越好？

lines.en: : Am I making it hard now?
lines.zh: : 我现在让你「难」了吗？

lines.en: scene toukadateday6
: That...
lines.zh: : 那话……

lines.en: : I believe you interpreted that in a way you were not intended to.
lines.zh: : 我想你把它理解成了我没打算表达的意思。

lines.en: : I’d believe you if you were wearing a different outfit.
lines.zh: : 你要换身衣服，我或许就信了。

lines.en: scene toukadateday7
: My...outfit has nothing to do with your perversion, Sensei! I should be free to wear what I want without your gaze lingering longer than it’s supposed to.
lines.zh: : 我的……穿着跟你的好色之心毫无关系，Sensei！我应该有穿自己想穿的自由，你的目光不该停留超过该停留的时间。

lines.en: : How long is it supposed to? What’s the max amount of time?
lines.zh: : 那该停留多久？上限是多少秒？

lines.en: scene toukadateday8
: Somewhere between two and five seconds. Long enough to not draw attention to the fact that there is any lingering at all.
lines.zh: : 两到五秒之间。长到既看了，又不至于让人察觉到「在盯着看」。

lines.en: : I’m kind of surprised to hear that you have an actual number.
lines.zh: : 我挺意外你居然有个具体数字。

lines.en: : Of course I have a number. It’d be irrational to expect everyone to completely ignore my assets. All I ask is that it be done in moderation and never mentioned verbally.
lines.zh: : 我当然有数字。指望所有人完全无视我的「资本」，那不现实。我只要求适可而止，而且绝不许说出口。

lines.en: : Then I will keep it in mind. Literally.
lines.zh: : 那我会记在心里。字面意义上的「心里」。

lines.en: scene toukadateday9
: Well done, Sensei. Now, take me away from here before anyone realizes what we’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 很好，Sensei。现在，趁没人发现我们在聊什么，快带我离开这儿。

lines.en: scene black
: On it.
lines.zh: : 遵命。

lines.en: : Oh, and please inform me of what we’ll be doing as I’ve only brought approximately 500,000 yen with me and have decided it will be best to keep my spending to a minimum as it’s grovel-day.
lines.zh: : 哦对了，请告诉我我们要干嘛——我只带了大约 50 万日元，而且既然是「赔罪日」，我决定把开销压到最低。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think that’ll be more than enough. And I’m not sure what we’re doing yet. But we’ll begin by going to your favorite place in the world.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得那绰绰有余了。我也还没想好干嘛。不过，我们先去你世上最喜欢的地方。

lines.en: : The Swiss Alps?!
lines.zh: : 瑞士阿尔卑斯山？！

lines.en: : The subway.
lines.zh: : 地铁。

lines.en: : I hate you.
lines.zh: : 我恨你。

lines.en: : Yeah, I know.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道。

lines.en: scene toukadateday10
Touka and I arrive in the urban district after a brief subway ride and begin to wander around in search of something that looks interesting to both of us.
lines.zh: Touka 和我坐了一小段地铁到了市区，开始四处逛，找我们俩都感兴趣的东西。

lines.en: The thing is, there isn’t much {i}at all{/i} that seems to interest both of us. The only thing I can think of that comes close is the movie theater, and all Touka wants to watch is horror.
lines.zh: 问题是，{i}根本{/i}没几样东西能同时勾起我俩的兴趣。我能想到最接近的只有电影院，而 Touka 只想看恐怖片。

lines.en: : We’ve passed several museums, Sensei. Did you not think to take me into any of those?
lines.zh: : 我们路过了好几家博物馆，Sensei。你就没想过带我进任何一家？

lines.en: : Museums don’t interest me.
lines.zh: : 博物馆勾不起我的兴趣。

lines.en: : Yes, but you don’t matter today.
lines.zh: : 是，可你今天不重要。

lines.en: : Well, that was rather blunt.
lines.zh: : 这话可真够直白的。

lines.en: scene toukadateday11
: Only because it’s true. If you want me to believe I hold a special place in your heart, you must go out of your way to prove it to me.
lines.zh: : 只因为那是事实。你要我相信自己在你心里有特殊的位置，就得特意做点事证明给我看。

lines.en: : I see no purpose in allowing you to lean on me in your time of need if you will not offer the same to me when {i}I{/i} require a shoulder.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}看不出，如果你在我需要肩膀时不肯给我依靠，我凭什么要在你需要时让你依靠。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize right now was a {i}time of need{/i} for you.
lines.zh: : 我没察觉你现在正{i}「需要」{/i}。

lines.en: : I suppose it’s less a time of “need” and more a time of “want.” But what I want is not so easily put into words.
lines.zh: : 我想这与其说是「需要」，不如说是「想要」。可我想要的东西，没那么容易说出口。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine it would be if it requires {i}my{/i} participation in any capacity. You’re sort of like ten leagues above me, Touka.
lines.zh: : 只要需要{i}我参与{/i}半点，我估计都「不容易说出口」。你比我高出不止一个档次，Touka。

lines.en: scene toukadateday12
: Oh, it’s far more than that. But it doesn’t change the fact that I enjoy your company far more than someone like me ever should. But we all have our flaws, and mine appear to be that I like you.
lines.zh: : 哦，高出远不止那点。但这改变不了一个事实：跟你相处，我享受的程度远超我这种人该有的。可人都有缺点，而我的缺点好像是……喜欢你。

lines.en: : Not unconditionally, though.
lines.zh: : 不过不是无条件的。

lines.en: : Would you prefer me as a mindless zombie who will love you no matter what?
lines.zh: : 你宁愿我做个不管怎样都爱你的无脑僵尸吗？

lines.en: scene toukadateday13
: You’d be easier to hang out with, that’s for sure.
lines.zh: : 那样你确实会好相处得多，这倒是真的。

lines.en: : I’m easy right now as well. You’re likely just over-thinking it. {i}Or{/i} not thinking at all, but I’m going to give you the benefit of the doubt since you {i}did{/i} show up today.
lines.zh: : 我现在也很好相处。多半是你想太多了。{i}或者{/i}压根没想——不过既然你今天来了，我就往好处想你。

lines.en: : Yeah. I kind of can’t afford to have you not liking me anymore. So if I need to put in some work to maintain our relationship every now and then, so be it.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我差不多承受不起你不喜欢我了。所以要是我得时不时花点功夫维持我们的关系，那就这样吧。

lines.en: : Oh, yay. I’ve always wanted to be someone’s {i}chore.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，好耶。我一直想当别人的{i}「家务活」{/i}。

lines.en: scene toukadateday14
: That’s not what I meant, Touka. If anything, {i}I’m{/i} the chore here.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思，Touka。要说「家务活」，{i}我{/i}才是。

lines.en: : You most certainly are. You’ve been a never-ending pain in my behind since the moment we first met.
lines.zh: : 你确实是。从我们第一次见面起，你就一直是我屁股后头甩不掉的麻烦。

lines.en: scene toukadateday13
: The first time we met was in Osako’s dojo. I didn’t become a pain until you were one of my students.
lines.zh: : 我们第一次见面是在 Osako 的道场。我到你成了我的学生之后才变成「麻烦」的。

lines.en: : I suppose you’re right.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。

lines.en: scene toukadateday15
: But it’s also because of you that I’m beginning to understand what “pain” is at all. And I can’t quite tell if I like it or not.
lines.zh: : 可也正因为你，我才开始明白「痛」到底是什么滋味。而且我说不清自己到底喜不喜欢。

lines.en: : What’s there to like about pain?
lines.zh: : 「痛」有什么好喜欢的？

lines.en: : The parts where it feels good.
lines.zh: : 喜欢它「爽」的那些部分。

lines.en: : Your mind is wandering again, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你的思绪又飘了，对吧？

lines.en: scene black
: I’m beginning to believe it’s not “wandering” at all and that you’re just leading it into the darkest corners of Kumon-mi on purpose.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得那根本不是「飘」，而是你故意把它往公文美最阴暗的角落里带。

lines.en: : On purpose? Now, why would I do that?
lines.zh: : 故意？我干嘛要那样？

lines.en: : Maybe you’re curious about what will happen there?
lines.zh: : 也许你好奇那里会发生什么？

lines.en: : Maybe I am? Then what?
lines.zh: : 也许我真好奇？然后呢？

lines.en: : Is something wrong, Sensei? You’re walking a little...{i}strangely{/i} all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Sensei？你突然走路有点……{i}奇怪{/i}。

lines.en: : Just keep looking forward, Touka.
lines.zh: : 往前看就好，Touka。

lines.en: scene toukadateday16

Eventually, our “date” leads us into a restaurant after we spend an hour or so wandering through a park — a park where Touka decided the best use of her money was lining the pockets of various street performers.
lines.zh: 最后，我们在一个公园逛了大约一小时后，「约会」把我们带进了一家餐厅——在那个公园里，Touka 认定她钱最好的去处是塞进各路街头艺人的口袋。

lines.en: And yes, she’s generous. This is what she does. But there’s a point where generosity becomes dangerous. And she’s just lucky no one has attempted to take advantage of that yet.
lines.zh: 是，她很大方。她就是这样的人。但大方过头就成了危险。她运气好，还没人想占她这个便宜。

lines.en: I could if I wanted to. I {i}know{/i} I could.
lines.zh: 我要是想，就能占。我{i}知道{/i}我能。

lines.en: scene toukadateday17
scene toukadateday16
But there is something else I want from her instead.
lines.zh: 但我想要的，是她身上别的东西。

lines.en: Something that can’t be bought.
lines.zh: 用钱买不到的东西。

lines.en: Or even understood by most — this endless Oedipal craving and the desire to both consume and {i}be{/i} consumed by a single being that my existence could both start {i}and{/i} end with.
lines.zh: 大多数人甚至无法理解的东西——这种无尽的恋母式渴求，以及被一个「既是我存在的起点、{i}也是{/i}终点」的对象吞掉、也{i}被它吞没{/i}的欲望。

lines.en: So she looks at me, and I look back at her.
lines.zh: 于是她看着我，我也回看她。

lines.en: But while she sees a fancy jewel or an interesting mechanical toy, I see a blanket and a ball-gag. And I feel the sensation of someone sneaking into bed beside me.
lines.zh: 但她看见的是一颗华丽的宝石、或一个有趣的机械玩具；而我看见的是一条毯子和一副口塞。我还感觉到有人钻进被窝、贴到我身旁。
: 那个……
: 那个……

lines.en: : I heard you had a conversation with my mother recently.
lines.zh: : 我听说你最近跟我母亲谈过一次。

lines.en: : I’ve had many conversations with your mother. But I’m reluctant to divulge the details of any of them.
lines.zh: : 我跟你母亲谈过很多次。但我不想透露任何一次的细节。

lines.en: : And why is that?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Two reasons. One — you don’t need to know. And two — you probably already do.
lines.zh: : 两个原因。一——你不需要知道。二——你多半已经知道了。

lines.en: scene toukadateday18
: I can see why you’d think that, but I assure you that my mother has no qualms at all with keeping information she does not wish to share away from me.
lines.zh: : 我懂你为什么这么想，但我向你保证，我母亲对于「把不想让我知道的事瞒着我」，毫无心理负担。

lines.en: : So if you know I was there, it would have to mean she {i}wants{/i} you to know I was there, right?
lines.zh: : 所以，既然你知道我去过，那只能意味着她{i}想{/i}让你知道我去过，对吧？

lines.en: scene toukadateday19
: Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : Or maybe I just have eyes.
lines.zh: : 又或者，我只是有「眼睛」。

lines.en: if tsukasaspring1 == True:
: The kind you personally see with? Or the kind your sister has that are just stationed around Tsukioka Manor?
lines.zh: : 是你自己用来「看」的那种眼睛？还是你姐姐安插在月冈宅邸各处的那种？

lines.en: : I see you’ve learned of Tsukasa’s henchmen. Interesting. How did that come to be?
lines.zh: : 看来你已经知道 Tsukasa 的「眼线」了。有意思。你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : Maybe I have eyes too?
lines.zh: : 也许我也有「眼睛」？

lines.en: : If you’ve been planting cameras around my home, I do hope you’ve omitted them from my bedrooms.
lines.zh: : 你要真在我家安了摄像头，但愿你没把它们放进我的卧室。

lines.en: : I’ll have them removed next week. Scout’s honor.
lines.zh: : 我下周就让人拆掉。童子军荣誉担保。

lines.en: else:
: You saw us?
lines.zh: : 你看见我们了？

lines.en: : Is that the conclusion you’ve drawn from that?
lines.zh: : 这是你从那句话里得出的结论？

lines.en: : It’s what you were implying, is it not?
lines.zh: : 那是你话里暗示的，不是吗？

lines.en: : All I’m doing is offering up a potential explanation. I never said I actually {i}saw{/i} anything.
lines.zh: : 我只是提供一个可能的解释。我可没说真{i}看见{/i}了什么。

lines.en: : Regardless of what {i}I{/i} know, though, I’d like to hear from you. What business do you have with my mother?
lines.zh: : 不过，撇开{i}我{/i}知道什么不谈，我想听你亲口说。你找我母亲到底什么事？

lines.en: : I think a better question is what business Tsubasa has with me. I can never figure out what the hell she’s trying to do. Especially now that the whole Chika situation is under control.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更该问的是，Tsubasa 找我什么事。我永远搞不懂她到底想干嘛。尤其现在 Chika 那档子事已经控制住了。

lines.en: : So she asked you for something?
lines.zh: : 所以她求你办什么事了？

lines.en: : I didn’t say that.
lines.zh: : 我没那么说。

lines.en: : You didn’t answer the question either. She did, didn’t she?
lines.zh: : 你也没回答我的问题。她确实求你了，对吧？

lines.en: : Why not just ask her?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛不直接问她？

lines.en: : Why not just tell me?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛不直接告诉我？

lines.en: : Because I have no idea what she’s okay with me sharing and acknowledge the fact that she could put me in prison whenever she wants.
lines.zh: : 因为我不知道哪些是她允许我说的，而且我清楚她随时能把我送进监狱。

lines.en: : True. But then she’d need to find someone else to pique her interest, and that doesn’t happen very often. And besides, I could put you in prison if I wanted to as well.
lines.zh: : 没错。但那样她就得再找个能勾起她兴致的人，而那种事可不常有。再说，我要想，也能把你送进监狱。

lines.en: : Sure. But then you’d need to find someone else to pique your interest, and I don’t think that happens very often.
lines.zh: : 当然。但那样你就得再找个能勾起你兴致的人，而我觉得那种事也不常有。

lines.en: : And you’d be right in thinking that. But there’s something I’d like to ask you, Sensei. Or rather...something I’d appreciate your participation in.
lines.zh: : 你这么想就对了。不过，Sensei，我有件事想问你。或者更确切地说……有件事想请你参与。

lines.en: : Oh good. Here we go again. Your family really has it out for me, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 哦太好了。又来了。你们家真是盯上我了，对吧？

lines.en: scene toukadateday20
: Sensei...all I want is for you to stop giving her the time of day.
lines.zh: : Sensei……我唯一想要的，是你别再搭理她。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : She’s gotten too interested in...{i}interfering.{/i} And I’d very much like her to mind her own business when it comes to my personal affairs. But, so long as you keep letting her tug your strings, she has no reason to stop.
lines.zh: : 她对……{i}「插手」{/i}我的事太上心了。我非常希望她别管我的私事。可只要你一直任她牵着鼻子走，她就没理由停手。

lines.en: : Is just knowing {i}you{/i} don’t want her getting involved not enough?
lines.zh: : 光知道{i}你{/i}不希望她插手，还不够吗？

lines.en: : Not when she knows I can’t and won’t do anything about it.
lines.zh: : 不够——当她明知我不能、也不会拿她怎样的时候。

lines.en: : But why not? You’re the...future heir or whatever, aren’t you? Can’t you leverage that to get her to back off?
lines.zh: : 可为什么不能？你不是……「未来继承人」什么的吗？你不能拿这个当筹码让她收手？

lines.en: scene toukadateday21
: Hah...no. That’s my duty, and it’s separate from my personal life. If I begin conflating the two, it’ll blur the lines my ancestors have so meticulously drawn.
lines.zh: : 哈……不行。那是我的职责，跟我的私生活是两码事。我要是把两者搅在一起，就会模糊祖先们精心划下的界线。

lines.en: : These two things must remain separate no matter what. Which means that the only thing I can {i}leverage{/i} is the fact that I’m my mother’s daughter and that I’d like some privacy.
lines.zh: : 这两者无论如何都必须分开。也就是说，我唯一能用的{i}筹码{/i}，是「我是我母亲的女儿」、以及「我想要点隐私」。

lines.en: scene toukadateday22
: But we Tsukiokas aren’t typically great when it comes to “privacy.” And that’s especially true for my mother who suddenly wants to know every explicit detail of my personal life.
lines.zh: : 但我们月冈家的人，在「隐私」这事上向来不在行。我母亲尤其如此——她突然想知道我私生活的每一个露骨细节。

lines.en: : But the strangest part is that she rarely expressed any interest in that until I began spending time with {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可最怪的是，在我开始跟{i}你{/i}来往之前，她几乎从不对这些感兴趣。

lines.en: : Well...why do you think that is?
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……你觉得是为什么？

lines.en: : I have my guesses. But I don’t think I can share any of them inside of a restaurant.
lines.zh: : 我有我的猜测。但我不觉得能在餐厅里说出来。

lines.en: scene toukadateday23
: If that {i}is{/i} what this place is, I mean. Because I’m not quite sure I’ve ever seen food that looks like this before.
lines.zh: : 我{i}是{/i}说，如果这地方还算「餐厅」的话。因为我不太确定自己见过长这样的食物。

lines.en: : That is fried chicken, Touka.
lines.zh: : 那是炸鸡，Touka。

lines.en: : Then why is it so shiny and round?
lines.zh: : 那为什么它又亮又圆？

lines.en: : Asset limitations. Just ignore it and look at me.
lines.zh: : 素材限制。别管它，看着我。

lines.en: scene toukadateday24
: Apologies.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : Talk to her if you don’t want her interfering. Don’t put that on me.
lines.zh: : 你不想让她插手，就自己跟她说。别把这担子压我身上。

lines.en: : Do you think I haven’t tried that? It’s as if she refuses to let me have {i}anything{/i} without also sharing it with her.
lines.zh: : 你以为我没试过吗？她好像就是不让我独占{i}任何{/i}东西，非得跟她分享不可。

lines.en: : It’s quite infuriating, to be honest. But there’s only so much I can do.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这挺让人恼火的。可我能做的也就这么多。

lines.en: : You can do way more than I can, Touka.
lines.zh: : 你能做的比我多得多，Touka。

lines.en: : Because even though Tsubasa hasn’t really done anything {i}bad{/i} to me yet, she knows enough about me that she definitely {i}could.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为，虽然 Tsubasa 还没对我做过什么{i}坏事{/i}，但她对我的了解，已经多到{i}「绝对办得到」{/i}的程度了。

lines.en: : But I don’t know enough about her yet to know if she actually {i}would.{/i} You know?
lines.zh: : 可我对她的了解，还不足以判断她到底会不{i}会{/i}那么做。你懂吧？

lines.en: : I suppose I understand what you’re saying. I just didn’t take you as the type to let someone like that boss you around.
lines.zh: : 我想我懂你的意思。我只是没想到，你是那种会任那种人摆布的人。

lines.en: : Then you don’t know me very well yet, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那你显然还不太了解我。

lines.en: scene toukadateday16
: Oh well. I suppose this just means that {i}I{/i} get to boss you around too now that I {i}know things{/i} about you.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。那看来既然我也{i}知道了你的事{/i}，{i}我也{/i}能对你发号施令了。

lines.en: : In a roundabout way, that’s almost what this date is.
lines.zh: : 拐个弯说，这场约会差不多就是这么回事。

lines.en: : In a roundabout way, I think I’d have to agree.
lines.zh: : 拐个弯说，我想我不得不同意。

lines.en: scene black
: But that calls into question just what {i}else{/i} I can get you to do for me...
lines.zh: : 不过这就引出一个问题：我{i}还能{/i}让你为我做什么……

lines.en: $ toukaspring1 = True
$ touka_love += 1
{i}Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Touka 的好感度上升到了 [touka_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump toukaspring2
